definitions: A basic level of service or product offered without charge, often with limited features or usage, to attract users or allow them to try the product before committing to a paid plan.
A complimentary access level to a digital service or platform, typically with restricted functionalities compared to premium, paid options.
examples: Many SaaS companies offer a free tier.
The free tier includes 5GB of storage.
Upgrade from the free tier for more features.
